description: You are a security engineer at a financial services company. The threat intelligence team has received the latest Feodo Tracker botnet Command and Control (C2) IP blocklist from abuse.ch. The blocklist has been downloaded and staged at /tmp/feodotracker_c2_ips.txt. Your job is to operationalize this threat intelligence by integrating it into Wazuh's detection engine so that any network activity involving these known malicious IP addresses generates a high-severity security alert (level 9 or above). You must use Wazuh's CDB (Constant Database) list feature to store the threat intelligence, and create custom detection rules that perform lookups against this list. The solution must be persistent — committed to Wazuh's configuration files — not just a temporary file. Dashboard login: admin/SecretPassword at https://localhost (accept SSL certificate warning). API credentials: wazuh-wui/MyS3cr37P450r.*- at https://localhost:55000.

metadata.description: Integrate Feodo Tracker C2 IPs into Wazuh CDB list with detection rules
